splash.tagline: A field QA workspace for seed lots

welcome.title: Meet your field QA workspace
welcome.body: A focused workspace for live capture, per-seed measurement, and grading. Designed for repeated, fast use.
welcome.cardCameraBody: Stream the viewfinder; tag detected seeds in real time.
welcome.cardTargetBody: Every record knows its pixels-per-mm source.
welcome.cardSyncBody: Capture offline; reconcile when you reach signal.
welcome.cardWorkspaceBody: A / B / C thresholds set per variety, applied per seed.

welcomePermission.title: Allow camera access
welcomePermission.body: Inspections need camera and microphone for live capture and recording. Location is optional, used only for auto-tagging.
